description: View Service - Haltestellennetz im Landkreis Vorpommern-Greifswald is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by service.geoportal-vg.de. This service is used to provide the network of stops in the Vorpommern-Greifswald district. This includes the public transport stops from the local transport plan (2017 to 2027) for the Vorpommern-Greifswald district and the university and Hanseatic city of Greifswald. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE View Service - Station network in the district of Vorpommern-Greifswald" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Nahverkehrskonzept, Bushaltestelle, infoMapAccessService, inspireidentifiziert, Landkreis Vorpommern-Greifswald. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
